notes_for_editor: Thin record. The Wikipedia list is the only source for the fate and the site description; the Central US Lookouts index names the tower with no detail. No build date, design, staffing, fires or access found after two searches; the story runs short for that reason. The record's access 'unknown' is left as is. A Facebook group comment mentioning a Sardis tower was not used because it cannot be verified. No photos found.
